text:
emma-recruiter: quick one candidate Mira (senior infra) accepted verbally but needs a comp-band uplift and sign-on split because she's relocating and wants tax timing help. proposed cash = $248k (base 150k / target 48k / sign-on 50k). asking for band E5 and sign-on 50% at start / 50% at 9mo. start date target 2026-08-10 but can be +/- 2 weeks.

nina-peopleops: pls drop offer packet + relocation tax note. confirm manager sign-off and whether sign-on gross-up is requested.

raza-hm: manager sign-off here. This is an urgent backfill; earlier start preferred. No initial gross-up request but manager asks contingency that we evaluate gross-up if dual-withholding arises.

emma-recruiter: uploaded packet: gdrive.com/mira-offer and gdrive.com/mira-tax. included market comps and counter-offer note.

anya-legal: heads-up  cross-border split payments often trigger withholding mismatches. We'll need local tax counsel and immigrant payroll ops input. If gross-up becomes necessary, legal wants an indemnity clause.

felipe-finance: finance needs FY1 cash timing and GL: ENG-INFRA-05. confirm whether sign-on is to be paid to overseas account or US account. also need the pro-rated base calc for month of start.

emma-recruiter: first-year cash estimate: pro-rated base ~$103k (Aug-Dec) + sign-on tranche $25k now + $25k at 9mo. sign-on to candidate US bank (they'll open before start).

offer-bot: Approval created REQ-2026-0821-33. Approvers: nina-peopleops, joel-comp, felipe-finance, anya-legal. status: Pending. link: https://rbwd/approvals/REQ-2026-0821-33

joel-comp: I'll review this afternoon. pls include 3 external market comps and internal parity snapshot. if committee approves uplift, we'll require a written contingency for gross-up escalation and budget source.

nina-peopleops: added note "candidate hold 72h" to request. also flagged packet as "time-sensitive backfill". @joel-comp can you push this if urgent?

raza-hm: candidate asked for confirmation in 48h due to competing offer. can comp-committee + legal do quick review?

joel-comp: i'll expedite. if we need a quorum call, ping me and i'll convene.

emma-recruiter: thanks — i'll keep Mira on a 48-72h hold and update thread as approvals move. :thumbsup:
